records.text: Unnamed people familiar with Erika Kirk's children told Candace Owens that the children in the photograph were neither Erika's son nor her daughter.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep 4DvYXBn_5JI)

appearances.snippet: but I abstained I completely abstained from that until I received information from people who would know who know the kids very well and said not only is that not her son it's not her daughter

verification.notes: The identification comes from unnamed private sources and concerns minor children whose faces were not publicly established in the reviewed material. Live searches found commentary repeating the allegation but no authoritative identification or source willing to be named. No conclusive evidence was available.

links.title: Source Says Neither Child Was Erika's
